provider_receipt.summary: Review found one evidence defect in the parent receipt: README.md and src/types.rs support the documented boundary and data model, but they do not independently establish the claimed policy behavior or receipt construction. Those claims depend on src/policy.rs and src/receipt.rs, which were not included in the parent tool evidence. Independent read-only inspection found the implementation consistent with the brief, but the parent receipt alone does not fully support its completion claim. The clean-tree evidence is valid as declared, and no modifications or artifacts were created.
